The [[Coronet Arms/Legends|Coronet Arms]] '''dueling pistol''' was a powerful, single-shot [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] typically sold in pairs. They were high-quality pistols designed to be used in a honor duel. They were useless at any great distance, but at the short distances employed in a duel, they were incredibly accurate weapons. Their power pack fired a single shot&mdash;all that was allowed in a duel&mdash;which was almost always lethal.<ref name="SoF" />
